name: What are the benefits of adding a casita to my property?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of adding a casita to my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a casita can offer several benefits, including increased property value, flexible living space for guests or family, potential rental income, or a dedicated home office or studio. It provides a private, detached area that enhances the functionality and appeal of your property. For multi-generational families, it can offer independent living while remaining close to loved ones, adding both convenience and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits of adding a casita include increased property value, flexible living space, potential rental income, or a dedicated home office. It enhances property functionality and appeal.
